description: Phase D — section fade combined: a single break boundary at frame 60 has clip A ending and clip B starting. fadeSeconds=0.5 (15 frames at 30fps). Track 0 holds clip A: starts at frame 0, duration=60, ends at 60 (fade-out). Track 1 holds clip B: starts at frame 60 (position=2_000_000us at 30fps), duration=60, ends at 120 (fade-in only -- no break at 120). At frame 50 clip A is mid fade-out (10/15~=0.667) and clip B is inactive (multiplier remains 1.0 at its identity default; it doesn't matter since clip B isn't in the active set at frame 50, but the helper computes it from the clip alone). At frame 60 clip A is at end-of-fade (0.0) and clip B is at start-of-fade-in (0.0). At frame 75 clip B is past its 15-frame fade-in window (1.0).
